annotations.title: How many used cars are listed in Ireland

description: Returns one number: the count of active used-car listings in Ireland, with a timestamp. No breakdowns and no prices. Use get_inventory_breakdown instead for county, make, turnover and freshness details. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

country.description: Market to query: IE = Ireland (default), GB = UK including Northern Ireland, ALL = both. Prices are always also given in EUR (GBP converted at the live ECB rate).
